config.signalscope.title: Signalscope settings
config.signalscope.stable_angle.descript: Maximum angle for stable reception. Must be smaller than the reception angle.
config.signalscope.reception_angle.descr: Maximum angle for reception. Adjusted if necessary to exceed the stable angle. Audio directionality is not implemented yet.
config.signalscope.voice_volume.descript: Reserved for directional audio, not implemented yet. Does not change voice volume in the current PoC.
config.signalscope.max_nicknames.descrip: Maximum number of player rows shown on the HUD, if space permits.
config.signalscope.radio_mode.descriptio: Hold the use button or press it once to toggle transmission.
